9.why: ManMix4st.cpp:290 tests this jack with isConnected and line 291 reads it with getPolyVoltage per channel, multiplies by that section's own gain and adds the result into the right-hand sum. With the jack empty and the Mono-to-stereo menu item on, which is how it starts, line 292 adds the section's already-gained left value to the right sum instead; that value is itself 0 unless the section's left jack has a cable in it. With Mono-to-stereo off an empty jack puts nothing into the right side at all.
